_comment: Merge into the live RTDB rules (Firebase console -> Realtime Database -> Rules). Socrates data lives at the root (letters/...), other schools under schools/$schoolId/letters/... . Confidentiality does NOT depend on these rules: company and confidential letters and the director signature are AES-256 encrypted in the browser. These rules add integrity: only a signed-in non-anonymous account (the director's Google login) can create or overwrite protected rows, the vault and the director signature; the audit log is append-only; lettersServer is reserved for the Cloud Functions.
